Three decades across Accenture, Capgemini, HCL, Tech Mahindra and Wipro — and in recent years working with enterprises and start-ups as advisor, consultant and full-time employee — operating across Americas, UK & Europe, ANZ and ASEAN. Three things have remained consistent: owning GTM motions for growth, translating technology into commercially viable enterprise Solutions, and building Delivery organizations at scale — while repeatedly being brought in to salvage at-risk red-flagged portfolios, solutions and business units, rebuilding stakeholder confidence and creating a credible path toward scalable growth.

The thought leadership thread has run parallel — co-authoring a globally published Testing Practitioners' Handbook, authoring whitepapers and process handbooks across DevOps, Quality Engineering and Delivery Governance, and representing organizations as keynote speaker, jury member at national and international forums and with the analyst community.
